meaning: 'verified' means an independent reader attested every item against the source. It does not upgrade any compliance claim, and the script cannot prove the reader's independence - it records the attestation.

verifier.statement: I read source.pdf directly via the alloflow_portable extract-text (ordered) and extract-annotations channels plus a second pdfjs-based text/position channel, dumped the font faces per page to confirm the three italic runs on page 1 and roman-only page 2, read the PDF metadata (Title, Language) and checked StructTreeRoot/MarkInfo bytes, viewed both extracted images with my own vision, then read alloflow-output-v2/source-accessible.html in full including its rendered Remediation notes. sha256 of the HTML and PDF match this worksheet's binding. I did not read repair-plan.json or any earlier worksheet or report, and I did not author the repair plan.
